description: This file defines a React functional component 'NoteList' that displays a list of notes or a placeholder message if no notes are available. It imports React, a Note type from an API, and a NoteItem component. The component takes props for notes, onSave, and onDelete functions, and renders either a message or a list of NoteItem components.
